questions.question: An amount of ₹870 is divided between Urmi and Kripa in the ratio of 18 : 11, respectively, whereas an amount of ₹960 is divided between Poorvi and Mrinal in the ratio of 5 : 7, respectively. Who gets the maximum amount of money among all four?
questions.solution:
An amount of ₹870 is divided between Urmi and Kripa in the ratio of 18 : 11

 
• Amount of money Urmi got = 18 / (18 + 11) × 870 = 18 / 29 × 870 = 540
 
• Amount of money Kripa got = 870 - 540 = 330 

An amount of ₹960 is divided between Poorvi and Mrinal in the ratio of 5 : 7

 
• Amount of money Poorvi got = 5 / (5 + 7) × 960 = 5 / 12 × 960 = 400
 
• Amount of money Mrinal got = 960 - 400 = 560

Clearly, Mrinal gets the maximum amount of money among all four.

Hence, '**Mrinal**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: A sum of money at compound interest amounts to seven times of itself in 3 years. In how many year will it be 2401 times of itself?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

A sum amounts to 7 times itself in 3 years

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal ×(1 +Rate/100)ⁿ

Where n = number of years

**Calculation:**

Let P be the sum of money and R = rate %

Amount after 3 years,

7P = P(1 + R/100)³

⇒ 7 = (1 + R/100)³ ---(1)

Let after 't' years amount becomes 2401 times of sum

2401 × P = P(1 + R/100)t 

⇒ 2401 = (1 + R/100)t 

⇒ 7⁴ = (1 + R/100)t ---(2)

On comparing (1) and (2) we get,

(1 + R/100)¹² = (1 + R/100)t

⇒ t = 12

**∴ After 12 years the sum will become 2401 times of itself.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/VnpydsfhbFlaZ5pOg1aDWNp0AcJ1CM1Ir9H-XCUwpv2tFt6Ef3O6Dc5-q_6XBsKhtCHPrb_FqFcTArnGY_sN-W3NwFT4vD_m235NUdr0fcgxrDi2fvI3odFQz7eV5ZtuzDeNXAb7wHSv6J-bk6_slEE] 

In the first 3 years, the amount becomes 7 times of principal

In the next 3 years, the amount becomes (7 × 7) 0r 7² times of principal

Hence, the amount becomes 7⁴ times of the principal in = 4 × 3 = 12 years

**∴ The sum becomes 2401 times itself in 12 years.**

questions.question: A man covers two-third of a certain distance at the speed of 70 km/h and the rest at the speed of 50 km/h. It takes him {6(4)/(5)} hours for the whole journey. At a speed of 56 km/h, in what time will he be able to cover the entire distance?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total time = 6(4)/(5) = (34)/(5) hrs

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the distance between the two points be '3X'

The person travels 2X distance with a speed of 70 km/h

He travels the remaining X distance with a speed of 50 km/h

Using the formula, for the whole journey

34/5 = 2X/70 + X/50

⇒ 34/5 = 17X/350

⇒ X = 2 × 70 = 140 km

∴ Distance (3X) = 140 × 3 = 420km

Time taken to travel this distance with a speed of 56 km/h,

Time = 420/56 = 15/2

Or Time = 7(1)/(2) hrs.

questions.question: For a certain sum, in 2 years, the simple interest is Rs. 80 and the compound interest for the same period at the same rate of interest is Rs. 85. The rate of interest per annum is:

Where P = Principal amount, R = Rate, T = Time** **

Simple interest (SI) is the rate percent of the principal amount

For example,

Or, CI (for 2 years) = SI for 2 years + R % × SI for 1 year
